Option2. =, This symbol is shown on a part of an inclined line of the upper right quadrant. So, not possible.

Option3. =, This symbol is shown on a part of an inclined line of the lower left quadrant. So, not possible.

Option4. =, This symbol is only shown on horizontal and vertical lines and not on any of the inclined or tilted lines.
